claims: The final round of the 2026 Masters is on Sunday, April 12, 2026.
Featured Groups coverage is available from 10:15 a.m. to 7 p.m. ET on Masters.com, Paramount+, and Prime Video.
Featured Holes (Amen Corner) coverage is available from 11:45 a.m. to 6 p.m. ET on Masters.com, Paramount+, and ESPN App.
Early Round 4 Coverage is available from 12 p.m. to 2 p.m. ET on Paramount+.
Final Round TV Coverage is available from 2 p.m. to 7 p.m. ET on CBS.
Green Jacket Ceremony coverage is available at 7 p.m. ET on Masters.com and Masters App.
Early coverage begins at 12 p.m. ET on Paramount+, featuring featured groups, Amen Corner, and holes 15/16.
Rory McIlroy entered Sunday with a share of the lead.
Rory McIlroy last won a major championship in 2014.
